title: The Largest Religious Monument on Earth
description: Angkor Wat in the 1100s, when the Khmer Empire built a temple-mountain to Vishnu.

scenes.narration: This is the largest religious monument on Earth, and it was built in just a few decades.
scenes.image_prompt: Angkor Wat with its five lotus towers reflected in water at sunrise

scenes.narration: It's the 1100s, in the Khmer Empire, in today's Cambodia. King Suryavarman the Second is building a temple to Vishnu.
scenes.image_prompt: Khmer king on an elephant before a huge temple under construction, 12th century

scenes.narration: A wide moat surrounds it, like an ocean around a sacred mountain.
scenes.image_prompt: wide moat around Angkor Wat with a long stone causeway, lush jungle

scenes.narration: Its towers are shaped like lotus buds, representing Mount Meru.
scenes.image_prompt: close view of carved lotus-bud stone towers of Angkor Wat against a blue sky

scenes.narration: Hundreds of metres of carvings show battles, gods and the churning of the ocean of milk.
scenes.image_prompt: long gallery of detailed stone bas-reliefs of gods and demons pulling a serpent

scenes.narration: The city of Angkor around it may have been one of the largest settlements of the pre-industrial world.
scenes.image_prompt: aerial view of the ancient Khmer city of Angkor with canals, reservoirs and temples

scenes.narration: Later it became a Buddhist temple, and it was never fully abandoned.
scenes.image_prompt: Buddhist monks in saffron robes walking through Angkor Wat galleries

scenes.narration: Its towers are on Cambodia's flag. Which temple should we visit next?
scenes.image_prompt: Angkor Wat at sunset with silhouettes of palm trees
